lines.text: 다현이와 이현이와 은우는 아침마다 창밖을 봐요.
lines.en: Dahyun, Ihyun, and Eunwoo look out the window every morning.
Up in the sky: one, two, three clouds.
Tap the clouds, tap tap tap, and count them!
Where do clouds come from? asked Dahyun.
Where from? Eunwoo says it too.
Kkulddeok lifts his nose and sniffs, sniff, sniff.
Woof! I smell clouds!

lines.text: 꿀떡이를 톡! 달려 나가게 해 줘요.
lines.en: Tap Kkulddeok to send him running!
Kkulddeok runs out the door.
Kkulddeok, wait for us!
Sniff, sniff. Kkulddeok just follows the smell.
Over the hill, across the meadow.

lines.text: 이현이는 길가 꽃을 살짝 만져 봐요.
lines.en: Ihyun gently touches the flowers by the road.
Tap the flowers, tap tap tap, and smell them!
Kkulddeok, how far are we going? asked Dahyun.
segs: Kkulddeok, how far are we going?

lines.en: On top of the hill, there is one chimney.
Tap the chimney, tap tap tap!
White clouds go pong! pong! out of the chimney.
Clouds come out of the chimney? asked Dahyun.
segs: Clouds come out of the chimney?

lines.en: Pong! Pong! Eunwoo says it too.
Under the chimney, a round door.

lines.text: 동그란 문을 톡! 같이 밀어 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the round door and push it together!
Ihyun gently pushes the door. Creeeak.
May we go in? asked Dahyun.
Kkulddeok pops in first.
This is the cloud factory!
Bubble, bubble, the cloud pot is boiling.
Tap the cloud pot, tap tap tap!
Pong! A white cloud. Pong! A puffy cloud.
Pong! Pong! the three siblings shout together.
Ihyun gives one cloud a tap.
Tap a cloud! What will it become?
Pong! The cloud turned into a bunny.
Eunwoo taps one too.
Tap another cloud!
Pong! This time, a fish.
Pong! Pong! Pong! Eunwoo is so excited.
There is a red button in the corner.
What is this? Can we press it? asked Dahyun.
segs: What is this? Can we press it?

lines.en: Ihyun reaches out... and stops.
Tap the red button! Eunwoo presses it.
Eunwoo pressed it with a big push!
Clunk! The machine shakes.
Pong... one little dark cloud came out.
Dark, tiny, and eyes full of tears.
Why are you crying? asked Dahyun.
How is the little cloud feeling?
I am not white. the little cloud sniffles.
Sniffle, sniffle, pitter-patter.
The cloud's tears fall down as rain.

lines.text: 다현이와 이현이와 은우와 꿀떡이는 흠뻑 젖었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun, Ihyun, Eunwoo, and Kkulddeok got soaking wet.
Ihyun gently strokes the little cloud's cheek.
Tap the little cloud, tap tap tap, and pat it gently!
I like rain! Let's put on boots and splash splash!
segs: I like rain! Let's put on boots and splash splash!

lines.en: Splash splash! Eunwoo jumps along.
Little cloud, do you want to play with us? asked Dahyun.
segs: Little cloud, do you want to play with us?

lines.en: Tap the lightning bolt!
Flash! Rumble, boom!
The little cloud got such a surprise that it made lightning.
Tap Kkulddeok and give him a big hug!
The three siblings hug Kkulddeok tight.
It is okay, it is okay. whispers Dahyun.
segs: It is okay, it is okay.

lines.en: It is okay. Eunwoo whispers too.
The little cloud wipes its tears.
Tap the little cloud's tears and wipe them away!
Am I... okay too?
It is okay! Rain is fun. the three siblings say.
segs: It is okay! Rain is fun.

lines.en: For the first time, the little cloud smiles.
The rain stops.
A rainbow in the sky!

lines.text: 무지개를 톡톡톡톡 눌러서 색깔을 세어 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the rainbow, tap tap tap tap, and count the colors!
Red, yellow, green, blue.
Who makes the rainbow? asked Dahyun.
Me! the little cloud says proudly.
Pong! Eunwoo claps.
The sun is setting. Time to go home.
Little cloud, let us play again!
segs: Little cloud, let us play again!

lines.en: Tap the little cloud and wave goodbye!
Kkulddeok leads the way. Sniff, sniff, the smell of home.
Eunwoo holds Ihyun's hand tight.

lines.text: 밤이에요. 다현이와 이현이와 은우와 꿀떡이는 창밖을 봐요.
lines.en: It is night. Dahyun, Ihyun, Eunwoo, and Kkulddeok look out the window.
One little dark cloud in the sky.
It waves at us.
Tap the little cloud and say good night!
Good night, little cloud.
Pong.
Its eyes are full of tears. It looks sad.
Tap sad!

ui.다현이와 이현이와 은우와 꿀떡이의 구름 공장: The Cloud Factory of Dahyun, Ihyun, Eunwoo, and Kkulddeok
ui.다음에 또 놀자, 먹구름아!: Let us play again, little cloud!
